title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the promote doors ask ADR-0029 D9.9's question the save door asks (#23630)
body:
Fixes #23630
Clause-②: no

## What this does

The save door refuses an `object` row bound to a package that does not own the object (ADR-0029 D9.9, `overlayPackageMismatchError`, `OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH` / `422`). A draft save is judged against the owner at the time of that save. So package Q's draft of an object that no row held yet was stored, correctly. Then package P saved a runtime-authored row of that object, and P owned it. Promoting Q's draft after that wrote Q's active row beside P's and answered success. The promotion never asked the save door's question. The registry write-through then refused the row into `applyObjectRegistryMutation`'s `console.warn` and kept serving P.

`promoteDraftForPublish` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) is the one promotion step that both doors call: the per-item publish (`publishMetaItem`, `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish`) and `publishPackageDrafts` (`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts`). It now asks `classifyObjectContribution(name, promoteInto)` after the gated draft read, and throws `overlayPackageMismatchError` on a `mismatch` verdict, before `repo.promoteDraft` writes. It is the save door's judge and envelope, unchanged: one refusal, no second dialect, no new code, no new message.

- **The package it judges** is `promoteInto`, the package the active row is written under. That is the stated binding, or, for a package-unbound draft adopted into the item's package (#23495), that package. The save door judges the address it resolved in the same way.
- **Placement.** It sits with the other draft-body refusals the promotion already asks: the `name` refusal, the permission-set owner binding, the default record page and the elevated flow. So a batch publish aborts on it as on them (ADR-0067 D2), and a publish with no draft at the address still answers `404 NO_DRAFT`.
- **Member 2 of the card** is the package-less owner (the `sys_metadata` sentinel). It is carried by #23514, which will change `classifyObjectContribution`'s sentinel arm; this PR does not touch that arm. #23514 remains open.

## Measured before the fix (real composition, base `57994c311f`)

Real `ObjectQL` over a real `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3), the real `PackageServicePlugin`, `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `HttpDispatcher.handlePackages`. Packages `com.probe.p` and `com.probe.q` are installed. Q's draft of `probe_ticket` is saved (`saveMetaItem`, mode draft), then P's active row is saved:

| door | answer | stored rows | registry owner / served label |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `publishMetaItem({ type: 'object', name, packageId: Q })` | `success: true`, "Published draft — type=object, name=probe_ticket [seq=3]" | `active:com.probe.p`, `active:com.probe.q` | `com.probe.p` / P's |
| `POST /api/v1/packages/com.probe.q/publish-drafts` | `200`, `outcome: 'published'`, `failed: []` | `active:com.probe.p`, `active:com.probe.q` | `com.probe.p` / P's |

The batch door's answer to a refusal inside a promotion was read from the code at the base. Any throw from `promoteDraftForPublish` rolls the batch back and answers `200` with `success: false` and `outcome: 'refused'`. The causal draft is in `failed[]` with its own `code` (`clientFacingFailureCode`; `OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH` is in the error-code ledger) and its message (a 4xx is quoted). Every other draft is listed `BATCH_ABORTED`. This PR keeps that declared shape (`PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema`) and adds nothing to it.

## Measured after the fix

New pin `packages/runtime/src/package-promote-runtime-owner-refusal.integration.test.ts`, 6 cases, on the same composition:

- **`publishMetaItem` naming Q:** throws `{ code: 'OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH', status: 422 }`, with `packageId` Q and `ownerPackageId` P. Its message equals the save door's refusal of the same row; the test compares the two answers and pins no wording. Nothing is written: active rows `[P]`, Q's draft still stored, and the registry serves P.
- **`POST /packages/Q/publish-drafts`:** `200`, `success: false`, `outcome: 'refused'`, `publishedCount: 0`, `failedCount: 1`. `failed[0]` is the object with `code: 'OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH'` and the save door's message. Nothing is written.
- **CONTROL:** with no second-package owner, Q's draft is promoted by `publishMetaItem` and by `publish-drafts` (active `[Q]`, registry Q).
- **CONTROL:** the owner P's own draft is published by `publish-drafts` over P's row.
- **CONTROL:** `publishMetaItem` naming no package still promotes a package-unbound draft INTO P (#23495's adoption).

Red before: at the base, 2 failed and 4 passed. The two refusal cases failed with "expected null to be an instance of Error" and `success: true`. Green after: 6 passed.

**Ablation**, at `5c2385ebd`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, with a trap restore):
- **Mutation:** the anchor `const layer = this.classifyObjectContribution(request.name, promoteInto);` was replaced by a planted non-`mismatch` verdict. Anchor count 1 → 0; blob `fa49911fd8` → `034c466abb`.
- **Build and dist proof:** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` was rebuilt. `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`.
- **Result:** predicted 2 red and 4 green; observed `Tests 2 failed | 4 passed (6)`, the two refusal cases.
- **Restore:** the blob equals HEAD `fa49911fd8` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The package was rebuilt; `--absent` found the marker in none of 24 built files and the tree clean. The pin then read `6 passed`.

## Tests

Every command ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, and each verdict is its `VERDICT command-exit` line. "Post-merge" is head `5298b986e`, which merges `origin/main` at `7e6e4e1da`; that range brings in #23659's `protocol.ts` delete-region change.

| command | result |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, as `--shard=1/3`, `2/3`, `3/3` (pre-merge and post-merge, identical) | exit 0 each · 236 files passed, 3 skipped · 20563 tests passed, 19 skipped |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2` on the new pin (post-merge) | exit 0 · 6 passed |
| objectql, 8 files that publish object drafts or pin D9.9 (`protocol-publish-package-drafts`, `publish-package-drafts-response-conformance`, `protocol-publish-rollback`, `protocol-commit-history`, `build-probes`, `protocol-save-permission-fls-key-forms`, `protocol-runtime-owner-overlay-refusal`, `protocol-object-overlay-layer`), post-merge | exit 0 · 109 passed |
| runtime, 6 files (`http-dispatcher`, `domains/meta-published-runtime-publish`, `domains/packages-publish-drafts-response-conformance`, the three `package-uninstall-*` integration files), post-merge | exit 0 · 282 passed |
| rest, 3 files (`meta-object-owd-gate`, `meta-write-door-capability-enumeration`, `meta-published-overlay`), post-merge | exit 0 · 90 passed |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol --filter @objectstack/runtime run typecheck` (pre-merge and post-merge) | exit 0 · runtime's `check:test-typecheck`: the test layer compiles, "27 file(s) / 190 error(s) / 68 pinned signature(s) held" (unchanged; the new pin adds none) |

The import-side runs are targeted, a declared narrowing. objectql, rest and runtime publish through this door, and their full suites (including each package's `repo` project) are CI's. The `turbo ls --affected` collection was not used to choose them; it is blind to tests that read another package's source from disk.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `5298b986e`, the final head, against merge base `7e6e4e1da`: 65 commands. All 65 ran at that head, each with its exit code captured before any pipe, and every one exited 0.

- **Two gates needed a second run.** `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no `dist/` / a lock queue timeout). After a full `turbo run build` under the lock (75 tasks, exit 0), both exited 0:
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: "110 published require entry point(s) across 68 package(s) load".
  - `check:type-check-debt`: "1 ledger entr(ies) re-measured … none above its recorded number".
- **`check-adr-0087-registration`:** `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on `.changeset/23630-promote-doors-d99.md`, marked BREAKING, bang, clause-② narrowing.
- **`--ran`:** "65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero, since every entry recorded its exit code.
- **The working tree** was clean after the build.

CI owns everything the derivation does not place: the artifact-roster and wide-population families, the type-check lanes, Test Core, Build Core, dogfood and the full objectql / rest / runtime suites.

## Acceptance notes

- **The batch door refuses inside its declared outcome, not with an HTTP 422.** `publish-drafts` answers `200` with `outcome: 'refused'` and the code and message in `failed[]`, the same shape as every other refusal inside a promotion (ADR-0067 D2, `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema`). The card's "same code and prescription" holds in `failed[0].code` and `failed[0].error`.
- **The `promoteInto` choice is pinned only on the paths where it equals the draft's own binding.** With a runtime owner, `promoteInto` differs from the draft key only for an adopted package-unbound draft. In that case `promoteInto` is the owner itself, so the verdict is `own` either way (the adoption CONTROL). The two answers diverge only with a code-packaged owner and a stored second-package row from before D9.9. In that state the save door refuses the same row, since it judges the address it resolves. That state is not pinned here.
- **`applyObjectRegistryMutation`'s note is now true of one more caller, and was left as is.** Its `mismatch` branch says it is unreachable from `saveMetaItem` and lists "rollback, publish promotion" as the other callers. Publish promotion now refuses at its producer too. The note stays true and sits outside this card's surface. `rollbackMetaItem` restores an existing row under that row's own binding, so it mints no new binding.
- **Rows stored before D9.9 stay as they are.** This change rewrites and removes nothing. The uninstall pre-flight (#23473) already handles them.
